entries.subject: DAMIT 180: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-180.txt. Model 180, version 2007-02-27, pole (84°, -15°), period 3.747455 h match the retained metadata. The archive diameter field is 85 ±8 km; its applicability to our scale is a separate calibration decision. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: The display scale in the astronomy record's mean radius 42.5 km (diameter 85 km) is outside the added Small Bodies Occultations V4.0 record 144, DAMIT model 180 diameter 74 ± 5 km (volume-equivalent; DAMIT model 180 fitted to 5 occultations). The display scale is not changed.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.
